mapper.select: SELECT ut.id,ut.user_id AS userId,u.name FROM user_todo AS ut JOIN users AS u ON ut.user_id = u.id WHERE ut.todo_id = #{id} AND ut.deleted != true ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_todo WHERE todo_id = #{todoId} AND user_id = #{loginId} )
